answer:
- **Champaign County, Illinois:** **2,586.01 km²**
- **Great-circle distance** between Trafalgar Square (51.5080° N, 0.1281° W) and Notre-Dame de Paris (48.8530° N, 2.3499° E): **343.89 km**, or approximately **344 km**.

The distance uses the haversine formula with Earth’s mean radius; great-circle distance is the length of the shorter arc between two points on a sphere ([Great-circle distance – Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great-circle_distance)).
